_comment: Third-party coupon sites, recorded so they are known and kept OFF. Coupons on Made4Buyers come only from brands' own official promotions pages (CommerceBrand.promoUrls). A row here is crawled only if an admin first records termsStatus APPROVED and then enables it. No start URLs are seeded; an admin adds them together with the written permission.
